system.description:
Cursed item (seems a battle axe +1). It is a battle axe +1. When you take damage in a fight, make a Will save or go berserk for the encounter: each turn you attack the nearest creature, friend or foe.

Monsters & Treasure, Cursed Items.

  • Identify shows only what it seems; once the curse shows, it can't be put down or taken off until Remove Curse frees the user, and the item stays cursed.
  • Valued as the item it imitates.
  • Save DC 15 unless the entry says otherwise.
